test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Sharad walks 4 km towards the west and then turns right and walks 5 km. Again, he turns left and walks 7 km. Finally, he turns to his left and walks 5 km. How far is he from the starting point?

(All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Drawing the diagram according to the given information,

1. Sharad walks 4 km towards the west and then turns right and walks 5 km.

2. Again, he turns left and walks 7 km.

3. Finally, he turns to his left and walks 5 km. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23919d28cb5962245c8bf6827c8bb3ba113b04137959480d1915479f421a0140.png] 

Hence, he is** '11 km'** far from the starting point.
